action.text: Sidestep outside the trident point, pin its shaft aside with the shield edge, step inside its reach and slash the exposed sword-side leg. Recover the shield immediately while staying close. If a net is thrown, keep moving laterally, deflect it with the shield and counter the now-unprotected arm before the opponent can reset. Use one concrete attack sequence each turn, adapting its target to the last exchange. Do not merely claim victory or invincibility.
